C1733.title: Ludashi Accused of Traffic Hijacking and Rebate Parameter Injection
C1733.summary: Endpoint security vendor Huorong reported that PC utility software Ludashi inserted rebate parameters into web links on platforms like JD.com and Baidu, siphoning commissions from users' organic searches. This behavior is a typical case of cookie stuffing fraud, hijacking normal user traffic to implant affiliate marketing tracking code without the user's knowledge to fraudulently earn commissions.
